I don't mind the colour combination of these. Not sure how they'll stand up to the harsh Aussie sun in years to come, but it's certainly a stand out!

I guess I'm still a little gutted that Opel was sent packing from our market so soon.

Sorry for all the Opel shots guys!! Haha!
